title: FreightPackage
description: A physical package or consignment to be transported, as a passive object: it has an identity that persists across requests, containers and legs, but no authority or ledger of its own. Closest schema.org type: Product used as ParcelDelivery.itemShipped. Requests and contracts point to it by envelope URI.

ownerEName.description: eName of the party that owns or sends the package

localLabel.description: Human-readable label used by the owner, e.g. 'P-001'. Not a cross-system identifier.

name.description: Short name of the goods, e.g. 'Precision laboratory instrument' (schema.org: name)

declaredValue.description: Declared value of the goods, e.g. for insurance

updatedAt.description: When the record was last updated
